CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content organization is asserted in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (red cell set) is identified and the same node lists an origin/kind that distinguishes its status/organization; all three features are explicitly present and bound to p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linking attention to content organization/access is present.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content (red cell coordinates) for a named node.

D.rationale: The node has a separate origin/kind field (e.g. copied_prior_record) distinguishing status of the recorded content from the content listing.

O.rationale: The origin and represented_time metadata describe how the content is organized/presented in the record for that node.
